collections.name: Australasia
collections.about: Birds of Australia and its neighbours, from the garden to the bush. Plates by John Gould, The Birds of Australia.

collections.name: Palearctic
collections.about: Native to Europe, North Africa and northern Asia (the rock dove now lives wild in cities worldwide). Plates by John Gould, The Birds of Great Britain.

collections.name: Nearctic
collections.about: Native to North America. Plate by John James Audubon, The Birds of America.

collections.name: Neotropics
collections.about: Native to Central and South America. Plate by John Gould, A Monograph of the Trogonidae.
